997-4681-5170-8292.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

5531-5694-6664-7487-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
5531-5694-6664-7487-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
5531-5694-6664-7487-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Zealous Lorecaster and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1809-2104-7370.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Returned Pastcaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1090-1594-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1669-1850-7705.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Moloid creature token.
Repeat.
1669-1850-7705.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1682-2366-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-6627.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to The Earth Crystal and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

851-4050-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
851-4050-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

2-225-539-1556.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost.
When Ancestral Statue enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4050-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4050-4210.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

4316-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1912-2043-2557-4715.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

147-5256-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

880-4677-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4677-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-3603-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Cloudshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3603-4477.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Cloudshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

413-1447-2719.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

880-2757-3678.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

882-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dwarven Blastminer, adding {R}.
When Dwarven Blastminer dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Dwarven Blastminer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Dwarven Blastminer's morph ability by paying {R}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

659-2178-2438.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Krenko.
Krenko does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Goblin.
659-2178-2438.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a Goblin token.
The Goblin dies, triggering Krenko, untapping Krenko.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4050-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4050-4302-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-456-2440-2871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Dragons and/or Illusions.
392-456-2440-2871.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Birgi and Manaform Hellkite trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Manaform Hellkite trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Seething Anger, causing target creature to get +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.

1304-2232-3990-4882.notablePrerequisites:
Nature's Chosen attached to Incubation Druid.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a land that can tap to produce {G}.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
1304-2232-3990-4882.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Nature's Chosen by paying {0}, untapping Incubation Druid.
Cast Frog Tongue by paying {G}, attaching it to Incubation Druid.
Frog Tongue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Frog Tongue trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Nature's Chosen from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Nature's Chosen by paying {G}, attaching it to Incubation Druid.
Nature's Chosen enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Frog Tongue from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
